facts.fact: The StackAdapt blog post 'Why programmatic trumps traditional in B2B lead gen' was published on 2026-02-19.
The article states that programmatic advertising has changed more in the last 15 years than most B2B teams give it credit for.
facts.quote: Programmatic advertising has changed more in the last 15 years than most B2B teams give it credit for.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's article says that programmatic now offers three things enterprise B2B teams need: channel consolidation, one-to-one adjustability, and stronger targeting, measurement, and insights across channels.
facts.quote: At its core, programmatic now offers three things enterprise B2B teams need:

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that nearly all premium inventory (CTV, digital video, DOOH) is available programmatically, and that inventory availability is no longer a constraint.
facts.quote: Just as important, inventory availability is no longer a constraint. Nearly all premium inventory (CTV, digital video, DOOH) is available programmatically.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that DSPs unify data, audiences, and measurement in one place, whereas point solutions often lack the scale needed for informed optimization.
facts.quote: Unlike point solutions, which often lack the scale needed for informed optimization, DSPs unify data, audiences, and measurement in one place.
